description: This file defines extension methods for grains in Orleans that are implicitly subscribed to streams, specifically providing a method to get the stream identity associated with such grains.

classes.name: ImplicitConsumerGrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for grains implicitly subscribed to streams.

methods.name: GetImplicitStreamIdentity
methods.description: Constructs and returns the StreamIdentity of the stream that the grain is implicitly subscribed to.
